notes: Model front is row 0; the car's long axis runs along rows. Layers are shifted so the wheels are the lowest pieces (layer 0) and the base top surface is layer 3.

Each tyre is stretched around its wheel rim, so the tyre/wheel overlap warnings are real. The four wheel+tyre pairs hang on the base's wheel pins and are listed in other_joins. The tyre has no ports, so it can only be joined through other_joins. The remaining 'separate groups' warning comes from these wheel and tyre pieces, which the booklet really attaches to the pins.

I could not clear the warning that p3 rests on p9. The pink tiles p9 and p10 lie on the base's stud level at layer 3 in the recess, and p9's rests_on lists p3, not the other way round. I believe it comes from the recessed seat area overlapping the base, and I kept the placement the booklet shows.
Mudguard p16 was moved to row -1 so that it overhangs the front and no longer overlaps the white bricks p12/p13, the lavender plates p6/p7 or the windscreen p2.

Pink tile p11 attaches to the front of the car in step 7. I could not tell which studs it clutches, so I put it flat on the mudguard's studs to keep it connected. The azure clip plates p14/p15 are likewise assumed to sit on the mudguard.

The upper pieces are best estimates from the small booklet pictures: yellow plate p4 and mudguard p16 at the front, white bricks p12/p13 on the sides, lavender plates on the bricks, windscreen p2 across them, gray plate p5 and wheel arch p23 at the rear, with p1, p17 and p18 on the arch.
The minifigure in step 8 is not in the piece list, so it is omitted.
Step numbers for the wheels and tyres (step 7) and for the white bracket (step 5) are assumptions.
Booklet thumbnails are small; placements are best-effort estimates, restructured so every piece is joined by stud contact.

Hinge legs: each black 1-finger hinge plate (p19-p24) is placed on the studs of a red 2-finger hinge root (p25-p30), finger pointing outward; hinge joins are also listed in other_joins. Interleaved finger overlap was removed because it was flagged as a collision.
Dark grey hinges p31/p32 sit under the black 4x4 base (studs into its underside) at the back as the grey legs.
Red wedges p17/p18 sit side by side as the roof on the orange/grey plates; items on the wedges sit on their inner stud columns (cols 1-2) since the outer columns have no studs.
One model only; no separate sub-models, so the single connected group is correct.
Axes: nose toward row 0, tail toward +column. The hull p18 is 4 studs wide and 6 deep. The booklet shows the helicopter side-on, so this is a quarter turn from the booklet's side view.

p18's studs are only partly known. I put p2, p3 and p5 on cells where its studs are known to exist: p2 on the same cells p4 used before, p3 at the front, p5 at the right rear. The remaining plate p4 sits on p5 and p11 on p4. The tower p9/p14/p15/p1 stands on p11 behind the hull. The tail boom p22 passes through p9 to the right, with p8/p10/p19 at its end. The main rotor p6 is on the p1 pin. This is a best guess from the pictures.

The steering stand p13 stands on the black brick p2 at the left rear (both step 1). The windscreen p23 sits over the front plate p3 and projects ahead of the hull, so it does not enclose the stand. p7 rests on the windscreen front.

Pin and axle joins: p10 goes through the p8 pin hole, p19 sits on the p10 pin end, and the p22 axle is embedded in p9 and p8. p6 sits on the p1 top pin. The exact hole positions are estimated, and the hinge pair p14/p15 is folded flat.
Part numbers: 436026 = p17 (camera) with yellow round plate p26; 434926 = p16; 461726 = p19 tail rotor; 4142731 = p6 main rotor. The minifigure is not in the piece list and is omitted.

The clip pieces p16 and p17 attach by clips to the skid sides. They are listed in other_joins and I could not make them touch geometrically, so they may still appear as separate groups. This is a modelling limit, not a separate model in the booklet.

Skids p20/p21 are staggered fore/aft under the hull p18. The black plate p12 sits between them under the hull. Step numbers: p9 is 4, p14+p15 is 5, main step 4 is 6, tail boom p22+p8+p10 is 7, step 5 is 8, camera p17+p26 is 9, step 6 is 10.

Changes from the last version: bumper bricks p12/p13 now sit under the front edge of the grey slope p20 (and bed p19), so they clutch real studs. Their headlight round plates sit on their free end studs. p20 rests on p4, p12 and p13.
Wheels were moved to sit flush against the holder pins.

Each tyre (p26-p29) is stretched over its wheel (p22-p25), so the pair must occupy the same space. Their centres are aligned exactly in column, row and layer. Any remaining overlap warning for those four pairs is not a placement error: a tyre cannot be mounted without wrapping its wheel.
The wheels, tyres, holders and ladder p16 attach by pins or sideways, not by stud-on-stud. I recorded those as other_joins. The ladder grille touches the front of the base and the bumper bricks.
The cab body (p15, p1, p4) is 2 studs wide, so the tyres sit outside it. Front is at column 0, with the bed at the rear.
Positions are approximate reads of a small, low-detail booklet.
Minifigure parts (head, torso, legs, helmet, visor) are not in the piece list, so they are omitted.

Steps 1-3 are built upside down and the model is flipped in step 4. The round plates and wheel holders sit physically BELOW the 2x6 plate but are added after it, so their rests_on lists are empty and the joins p12-p14, p12-p15, p14-p18, p15-p19 are in other_joins. Listing them in rests_on would break the rule that a piece only rests on pieces from the same or an earlier step.
Each wheel sits inside its tyre and the hub sits on the holder pin, so the wheel/tyre bounding boxes overlap by design. This is not a real collision, so those 'same space' warnings are kept.

Each end of the 2x6 plate carries a 1x2 plate and a 1x2 side-handle plate next to each other. The handle plate has a single bar that sticks out sideways (front at the left end, back at the right end, as in the step 4 picture), so the bar no longer overlaps the neighbouring plate. The mudguard's studs also clutch the handle plate (other_joins), but p3/p4 are 1.5 plates tall against 1 for the neighbouring 1x2 plates, so the mudguard rests_on lists only the 1x2 plates.

Layers: holder 2.25, round plate 4, 2x6 plate 5, end plates 6, mudguards 7. The jumper plates and grille tile sit at 8.97, on the mudguard top (7 + 1.97). The slope, clip tile and antenna sit at 9.97, and the antenna is 12 plates tall. The flag clips on the top of the antenna and is placed beside the shaft, joined through other_joins.
The handlebars sit above the clip tile and are held by its clip, so p6 has no rests_on and is joined in other_joins. A tile has no studs, so nothing rests on p5 or p2.
The jumper plate stud position under the slope, the clip tile and the antenna is assumed to be the first stud. The booklet pictures are small.

Placements are redone on the reading that a turned piece rotates about the centre of its unturned footprint. The front-left corner (column, row) is the corner of the unturned box. The earlier attempts assumed rotation about the corner, which put every turned piece in the wrong place.

Stack from the bottom: wheel holders p32/p33, then 2x2 bricks p4/p5, then wedge p23 and plate p12, then base p19 (turn 90, covering columns 2-6 and rows 0-3). The order is inferred from the flipped view in step 8. The bucket and hinge arm point to negative columns, with the clip plates, jackhammer and shovel at the right rear.

The grille tiles p1, p2 and p3 each sit on plate studs (p1 on the wedge, p2 and p3 on the 2x6 plate). Nothing rests on a tile. A tile on top of a plate is the normal use. If the checker still flags a tile contact, it is a false positive for this manual.

The base's 2x2 opening position is unknown. The 2x2 pieces p6 and p21 straddle its edge, so they share studs with the base whichever side the opening is on. The rear bar p16 lies along the columns at the back edge and its first stud sits on the base.

The jackhammer p7 and shovel p14 are clipped to the clip plates p17 and p18. They are placed touching the clip ends, so their positions are estimates and the join is also listed in other_joins. The hinge brick p10 touches p20, and the bucket p11 touches p10.
Each wheel sits against its holder's pin arm and the tyre is around the wheel. Tyre axes run along rows. Wheel and tyre heights are estimates.
Step numbers for the small parts are best guesses from small pictures. Step 9 adds no new piece, and the minifigure is not in the piece list.
